body.name: coarsen
body.def: \(K\to L\) or \(K\leftrightarrow L\) occurs in \(\operatorname{clust}_{C}(G)\) exactly when an edge of that type occurs in \(G\) between some labelled vertices in \(K\) and \(L\); declared self-loops use the same existential convention within a cluster.
body.role: Defines exact compatibility between micrographs and the cluster diagram.
